citations.quote: Members and candidates must understand the applicable laws and regulations of the countries and jurisdictions where they engage in professional activities.
Members and Candidates must use reasonable care and judgment to achieve and maintain independence and objectivity in their professional activities.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard I.A requires Members/Candidates to understand and comply with all applicable laws and regulations governing their professional activities, including the more-strict-of-law-or-Standard rule for cross-border conduct; I.B requires reasonable care and judgment to maintain independence and objectivity around gifts, soft dollars, and analyst-coverage pressure.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard I(A) Knowledge of the Law and I(B) Independence and Objectivity
